title: MapLibre Web Application
note: browser frontend is spec-level, backend API tested
negative_results: The browser frontend (TypeScript/React/Vite/MapLibre GL JS) is NOT built in this Python repository's pytest gate; it is delivered as a precise UI specification against the P57 backend service API.
No cwatlas code, tests, schemas, __init__, claims, pyproject, or build_meta were modified; docs only.
No service.py exists yet in cwatlas; the spec references the P57 service API as a thin JSON wrapper over the tested cwatlas module functions, naming each underlying call.

claims.statement: The 2D map app renders the tested engine's results and receipts; every UI action maps to a named P57 endpoint and a tested cwatlas function, adding no independent transform.
A map pin is never produced without a declared CRS and epoch (invariant 9); the UI surfaces refuse_pin_without_crs_epoch rather than defaulting.
A legacy vector is never forced to one pin; a single uncalibrated candidate renders as a REGION via vector_to_pin_ux.decide_pin_state.
A pasted source vector does not identify a real location; it yields a pin, alias set, region, heatmap, or refusal.

privacy_check: CLEAN - synthetic fixtures only, no private inputs
